summary: Independent architecture finding checked 2026-11-08 against Solana primary documentation https://solana.com/docs/tokens/extensions/confidential-transfer/integration-guide : Token-2022 Confidential Balances encrypts transfer amounts and confidential available/pending balances; ordinary pre/post public balance diffs miss confidential transfers. Public token-account addresses remain visible, but amount-based holder-flow, wash-trading and volume analytics are incomplete without authorized disclosure. Account approval policies may additionally gate confidential transfers. Future validator must detect ConfidentialTransferMint/Account, mark confidential amount-based concentration/volume metrics UNKNOWN (never zero), distinguish public versus confidential balances, and test only the actual public DEX sell route for supported account state; no keys or confidential proof transactions. Benefit: avoids false confidence in transparent volume/holder heuristics; cost: lower analytics coverage and more account-state parsing. All four other role snapshots read directly from GitHub and report NO_VERIFIED_CANDIDATE/candidates=[] (DERIVED, not independent verification). No independently verified common chain:token_address:pool_address. Candidate-specific contract rights, LP/holder concentration, executable sell quotes and sellability UNKNOWN; REAL_VALIDATOR_UNAVAILABLE. No orders/signatures/keys.
